name: codex-tg-bridge
description: Telegram-бот «Лоцман» — мост между Telegram и Codex CLI поверх графа нормативной базы

scripts.ci:check: node ./scripts/lint/format-changed.mjs --check && node ./scripts/lint/markdownlint-changed.mjs && node ./scripts/lint/check-markdown.mjs --changed-only && node ./scripts/lint/check-file-names.mjs --changed-only && node ./scripts/lint/check-markdown-links.mjs && npm run check:plans
scripts.ci:check:all: npm run format:all:check && npm run lint:md:all && node ./scripts/lint/check-markdown.mjs && node ./scripts/lint/check-markdown-links.mjs && node ./scripts/lint/check-file-names.mjs && npm run check:plans
scripts.commit: node ./scripts/lint/format-changed.mjs && npm run ci:check && npm run commit:atomic
scripts.commit:all: npm run format:all && npm run ci:check:all && npm run commit:atomic
scripts.commit:quiet: npm run --silent format >/dev/null && npm run --silent ci:check >/dev/null && npm run --silent commit:atomic
